intramuros.name: Intramuros
intramuros.price_text: Free to walk · museum and church fees extra
intramuros.hours: Walled city streets always open · museums usually 09:00–17:00, check on the day
intramuros.tip: Walk or take a kalesa (horse cart) inside the walls; agree the fare before you ride.
intramuros.best: Early morning or late afternoon; hot at midday

fort-santiago.name: Fort Santiago
fort-santiago.price_text: Around PHP 75 for adults · students and seniors discounted · check on the day
fort-santiago.hours: Daily roughly 08:00–18:00 · check on the day
fort-santiago.tip: See the Rizal shrine and walk the walls for river views.

san-agustin.name: San Agustin Church
san-agustin.price_text: Museum entry around PHP 200 · church visit may be free · check on the day
san-agustin.hours: Church open daily · museum roughly 08:00–12:00 and 13:00–18:00 · check on the day
san-agustin.tip: The oldest stone church in the country; the attached museum is worth the small fee.
san-agustin.best: Any time; quietest in the morning

rizal-park.name: Rizal Park
rizal-park.price_text: Free · some gardens and museums charge
rizal-park.hours: Roughly 05:00–21:00 daily · check on the day
rizal-park.tip: Go early for locals exercising; the Rizal Monument is the photo stop.

abs-cbn.name: ABS-CBN Studios Experience (Closed)
abs-cbn.price_text: Closed · do not plan a visit
abs-cbn.tip: This attraction is closed; skip it and check local listings for anything similar.

adobo.name: Adobo (classic Filipino dish)
adobo.price_text: Around PHP 150–400 per plate in casual restaurants · check on the day
adobo.tip: Try both the pork and chicken versions; every family has its own recipe.

binondo.name: Binondo
binondo.price_text: Free to walk · food tour fees extra
binondo.hours: Streets busy roughly 08:00–20:00 · many shops close Sunday
binondo.tip: The world's oldest Chinatown; come hungry for dumplings and hopia.

bhs.name: Bonifacio High Street
bhs.price_text: Free to walk · shops and food extra
bhs.tip: Good for an evening stroll, coffee and people-watching in BGC.

chooks.name: Chooks-to-Go
chooks.price_text: Around PHP 90–200 for roast chicken meals · check on the day
chooks.tip: Cheap roast chicken to take away; a quick budget meal.

christmasaya.name: ChristmaSaya Carnival
christmasaya.price_text: Ride tickets sold on site · prices vary by season · check on the day
christmasaya.hours: Seasonal, often evening hours · check on the day
christmasaya.tip: A seasonal fair; confirm dates and location before you go.

circle-of-fun.name: Circle of Fun
circle-of-fun.price_text: Ride tickets sold on site · check on the day
circle-of-fun.hours: Roughly afternoon to evening · check on the day
circle-of-fun.tip: Small carnival rides; good with kids, confirm it is open that day.

dreamplay.name: DreamPlay
dreamplay.price_text: Ticket prices vary · check on the day
dreamplay.tip: Indoor family play area near the bay; confirm it is open before travelling.
dreamplay.best: Any time; good for rainy days

fiesta-carnival.name: Fiesta Carnival
fiesta-carnival.price_text: Ride tickets sold on site · check on the day
fiesta-carnival.tip: Indoor carnival rides at a mall; check opening hours on the day.

greenbelt.name: Greenbelt
greenbelt.price_text: Free to walk · shops and food extra
greenbelt.tip: Shaded gardens and chapels between the malls; a calm break in Makati.

jollibee.name: Jollibee
jollibee.price_text: Around PHP 80–200 per meal · check on the day
jollibee.tip: Try Chickenjoy with rice; branches are everywhere and cheap.

kidzania.name: KidZania Manila (Closed)
kidzania.price_text: Closed · do not plan a visit
kidzania.tip: This attraction is closed; skip it.

mang-inasal.name: Mang Inasal
mang-inasal.price_text: Around PHP 100–250 per meal · check on the day
mang-inasal.tip: Grilled chicken with unlimited rice; a cheap, filling local chain meal.

baywalk.name: Manila Baywalk
baywalk.tip: Come for the sunset over the bay; keep valuables close in the evening.

ocean-park.name: Manila Ocean Park
ocean-park.price_text: Ticket bundles vary · check on the day
ocean-park.tip: Good rainy-day option with kids; buy tickets online to skip queues.

quiapo.name: Quiapo Market
quiapo.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item
quiapo.tip: Crowded and lively; watch your bag and go with a local if you can.

sm-by-the-bay.name: SM By the Bay Amusement Park
sm-by-the-bay.landmark: SM By the Bay Amusement Park
sm-by-the-bay.price_text: Ride tickets sold on site · check on the day
sm-by-the-bay.hours: Roughly afternoon to evening · check on the day
sm-by-the-bay.tip: Rides by the bay; the Ferris wheel view at sunset is the draw.

moa.name: SM Mall of Asia
moa.price_text: Free to enter · shops and food extra
moa.tip: Huge mall by the bay; walk the waterfront behind it at sunset.

binondo-food-tour.name: Binondo food walk
binondo-food-tour.price_text: Around PHP 800–1,800 per person · check on the day
binondo-food-tour.tip: A guided tasting walk is the easiest way to try many Chinese-Filipino dishes.

legazpi-market.name: Legazpi Public Market
legazpi-market.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item
legazpi-market.tip: Local wet market in Makati; go early for the freshest produce and cheap eats.

paco-park.name: Paco Park
paco-park.price_text: Free or small fee · check on the day
paco-park.tip: Quiet old cemetery-turned-garden; a calm stop between Intramuros sights.

escolta-walk.name: Escolta street walk
escolta-walk.hours: Daytime hours; some shops close Sunday
escolta-walk.tip: Old commercial street with heritage buildings and small cafes; walk it in daylight.

bay-sunset-cruise.name: Manila Bay sunset cruise
bay-sunset-cruise.price_text: Around PHP 500–1,500 per person · check on the day
bay-sunset-cruise.tip: Book ahead and confirm the meeting point; sunset is the best slot.
